افتتحت (form VIII)
# اِفْتَتَحْتُ (iftataḥtu) /if.ta.taħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# اِفْتَتَحْتَ (iftataḥta) /if.ta.taħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# اِفْتَتَحْتِ (iftataḥti) /if.ta.taħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# اِفْتَتَحَتْ (iftataḥat) /if.ta.ta.ħat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
